raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The DE-398 refactor on 2026-01-16 changed silver_transactions to derive txn_date from ingest_ts, the batch load time, which is always the next day at 02:00. As a result every POSTED row (4699) is assigned the wrong business date, and the date-keyed gold aggregates are shifted by one day. txn_date should come from txn_ts; transaction times fall between 06:00 and 23:00, so there is no midnight ambiguity.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
